title: Hilbert, whose AI software connects data across teams to help companies make decisions from a single system, raised a $28M Series A led by a16z (Madison Mills/Axios)
summary: Madison Mills / Axios: Hilbert, whose AI software connects data across teams to help companies make decisions from a single system, raised a $28M Series A led by a16z — Hilbert, an AI startup rethinking how companies drive growth, raised a $28 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, the startup told Axios exclusively.
